column3: sent forward early before settling third - short of room over 1f out - found a gap and moved to the front inside final furlong - ran on strongly
tracked the pace - went in front over 1f out before being overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on
settled towards the back of the field - made progress on the outer over 2f out - drifted left over 1f out - closed on the front pair to take third
settled at the back early - shifted out and made progress over 2f out - on terms 1f out before drifting left - kept on to finish fourth
went to the front early and was pushed along over 2f out - overtaken over 1f out - faded inside final furlong
settled towards the back - made progress under pressure 2f out - closed on the pacesetter approaching the furlong - fought out a prolonged battle in the last furlong - got up to win
tracked the pace - went on 3f out - driven along 2f out - pressed hard approaching the final furlong - fought it out before being overhauled close home
settled towards the back - made ground 2f out - driven approaching the last - kept on well to take third
advanced from the pack under pressure 2f out - ran on without a change of gear inside the final furlong
raced in the pack - made ground 2f out and driven approaching the last - ran on inside the final furlong
tracked the pace - driven 2f out and looked capable of a big run approaching the last - faded inside the final furlong
held up towards the back - made ground 2f out - short of room approaching the last - found more inside the final furlong without getting any closer
settled towards the back and made ground under pressure over 2f out - made no more show in the closing stages
held up towards the back - made ground 2f out and driven approaching the last - took no real part in the finish
raced in the pack - driven and made ground over 2f out but found nothing - faded inside the final furlong
raced in the pack - driven over 2f out and short of room into the straight - made no further impression
slow to begin - fought back to regain the front - came under pressure and lost the advantage 3f out - in trouble a long way out - lost more ground over 1f out
raced up with the pace - driven over 3f out and slipped to the back by 2f out - in trouble a long way out
settled in the pack and up to 6th 4f out - roused and closing ground early in the straight - 2nd and driven over 2f out - quickened to the front inside final 150 yards and ran on for the win
set the pace - shaken up to open a four length advantage entering the straight - soon under pressure - overtaken inside final 150 yards and had no answer to the winner

slow into stride and needed driving early towards the back of the field - made ground into 9th 2f out entering the straight - angled left and driven into 5th over 1f out - finished strongly into third final 100 yards
settled towards the back of the field early - driven and improving on the outside early in the straight to be 5th 2f out - up to 4th over 1f out and stayed on well inside the final furlong
settled in the pack and needed rousing into 9th approaching the straight - improved to 7th with 2f to run and driven - finished without further improvement in the final furlong
up with the front runners and 3rd halfway - driven over 2f out without making further ground over 1f out - found nothing more inside the final furlong
settled in the pack and up to 8th 4f out - up to 4th and driven 2f out - faded to 6th and found nothing more over 1f out
settled in the pack and needed urging dropping towards the back approaching the straight - 8th and driven 2f out - held the same level to the line
up with the front runners - 4th halfway before needing urging and fading entering the straight - soon driven without finding more
settled towards the back - travelled easily - asked for effort without making ground early in the straight - failed to threaten and continued at the same level to the line
up with the front runners and 5th 4f out - driven 2f out without finding more - not knocked about from over 1f out
up with the front runners and 5th halfway - needed urging and dropped back approaching the straight - found nothing more from 2f out
settled at the back throughout and failed to threaten - driven without making ground entering the straight - found nothing more from 2f out
close up early and 2nd halfway - driven 4f out without finding more early in the straight - faded - dropped right away and finished a distant last
settled towards the back - made rapid progress from 3f out - short of room over 2f out before moving left - went to the front inside final furlong - ran on strongly
settled at the back - made progress despite being short of room over 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong but couldn't peg back the leader - stayed on

unhurried start but soon on terms - up with the front runners over 6f out before moving to the front 3f out - drifted left - bumped another runner and was overtaken 2f out - held a steady gear to the line
travelled comfortably before dropping away 6f out - unable to threaten but stayed on final furlong
went to the front early and stayed close up - drifted left - bumped another runner and moved back in front 2f out - overtaken over 1f out - faded final 110 yards
settled towards the centre of the field before making ground on the outer 6f out - drifted left and dropped back over 1f out
went to the front early - overtaken over 3f out before fading over 2f out
tracked the pace - driven 2f out - eased right approaching the last - quickened to hit the front and drifted left inside the final furlong - asserted without being fully tested to the line
raced in the pack - driven and made ground 2f out - ran on strongly inside the final furlong but denied close home
held up towards the back - driven and made ground over 2f out - asked for more approaching the last - ran on strongly to be closest of all at the line
set the pace - driven over 2f out - opened up a two-length advantage over 1f out - advantage narrowed through the final furlong - lost the front 110 yards out but battled to the line
messy start - regained ground to track the pace - driven 2f out - closed in to dispute matters over 1f out - hampered inside the final furlong and could not fight back
fought the bridle in the early stages - settled in the pack - came under pressure and made ground 2f out then asked again approaching the last - ran on without a further turn of foot to the line
raced in the pack wide - came under pressure 3f out and driven over 2f out - took no part in the finish
sluggish start towards the back of the field - driven and made only slight ground over 2f out - made no more show in the closing stages
fought the bridle early up with the pace - driven and dropped away from the pace 2f out - faded over 1f out
up with the front runners - ran wide on the bend after 3f but still 3rd halfway - up to 2nd and driven 2f out - driven to the front over 1f out - drew clear and won comfortably

settled towards the back and needed urging approaching the straight - up to 5th and driven with 2f to run - made no ground over 1f out - stayed on inside the final furlong for a laboured second near the finish

set the pace - overtaken for a spell after 3f and passed once more 4f out - 3rd and driven 2f out - found nothing more from over 1f out

settled at the back throughout - needed urging without making ground entering the straight - found nothing more with 2f to run and dropped right away in the final furlong
settled at the back - made progress over 1f out - moved right soon after - ran on strongly and drifted left inside final 110 yards - went in front towards finish as tack shifted late on

pulled hard early while towards the centre of the field - made progress over 4f out - moved left over 2f out - went upsides and veered left inside final furlong - soon in front - overtaken towards finish
went to the front early - drifted left on the bend 5f out - drifted left again over 1f out and markedly so inside final furlong - soon overtaken and unable to threaten in third towards finish
tracked the front-runners - pushed along and passed while drifting left over 1f out - found nothing extra
went to the front early before dropping to track the pace - drifted left on the bend 5f out - pushed along over 1f out - faded inside final furlong
slowest away and settled at the back - stayed on final 75 yards without threatening
settled towards the back on the outer - pulled hard but played no part
settled towards the centre of the field - driven and niggled at on the outer over 2f out before fading over 1f out

tracked the pace - driven approaching the last - ran on strongly but narrowly denied

settled in the pack before making ground under pressure over 2f out - ran on inside the final furlong
raced up with the pace - driven over 2f out and still holding claims approaching the last - faded inside the final furlong
settled towards the back of the pack and came under pressure over 2f out - ran on without finding more in the final furlong
set the pace - lost the advantage 3f out - driven over 2f out - in trouble a long way out and faded over the final furlong
raced in the pack and was driven and passed by rivals over 2f out - took no part in the finish
fought the bridle early towards the back - driven hard 3f out - struggled for pace throughout
held up towards the back and came under pressure over 2f out - took no part in the finish
soon went to the front - challenged approaching the straight - asked for effort with 2f to run - soon asserted and pulled away inside the final furlong to win comfortably

went to the front early - settled on the heels of the front pair and 3rd halfway - driven over 2f out - up to 2nd and driven with 1 1/2f to run - unable to get to the winner and held the same level to the line
settled in the pack - up to 4th and driven early in the straight - unremarkable in third 1f out and held the same level to the finish
settled towards the back - up to 5th and driven early in the straight - unremarkable in fourth 1f out and held the same level to the finish
settled in the pack and 6th halfway - driven over 2f out without making ground and found nothing more inside the final 150 yards
up with the pace - 2nd halfway and put under pressure approaching the straight - driven over 2f out - drifted left and brushed the rail in third with 1 1/2f to run and found nothing more
settled towards the back and failed to threaten - 7th and driven over 2f out - found nothing more from over 1f out
settled at the back throughout and failed to threaten - found nothing more early in the straight
up with the front runners and 4th halfway - driven 4f out and soon beaten into the back markers - found nothing more and allowed to finish in own time from over 1f out
settled at the back before shifting left and making progress over 1f out - went to the front inside final furlong - stayed on gamely

settled towards the back - short of room while making ground from over 2f out - hampered over 1f out - moved left inside final furlong - ran on into second towards finish without quite catching the winner
tracked the pace - short of room over 2f out - moved left soon after - went upsides over 1f out and up front for a stride inside final furlong - surrendered second towards finish
settled towards the back - made progress despite being short of room over 1f out - stayed on to take fourth comfortably inside final furlong
tracked the pace - went to the front over 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong with nothing more to find in the final 75 yards
handy early - moved out to the outer over 2f out before fading inside final furlong
away smartly in front - overtaken over 2f out and faded inside final furlong
tracked the pace along the rail - short of room over 2f out - dropped back and squeezed for room entering final furlong
unhurried start - spent the race towards the back of the pack
settled towards the centre of the field - dropped back 4f out and adrift of the pace over 2f out
tracked the pace - dropped away over 2f out before fading over 1f out
tracked the pace on the outer - drifted left and dropped back over 2f out and was not knocked about final furlong

up with the front runners and 3rd halfway - back to fourth and driven with 2f to run without finding more inside the final furlong
settled towards the back - 6th halfway and needing urging early in the straight - driven without making ground with 2f to run and found nothing more in the final furlong
settled at the back throughout and failed to threaten - driven with 2f to run and found nothing more in the final furlong

settled towards the centre of the field despite pulling hard - made progress from 2f out - up to second entering final furlong - drifted left towards finish - in front on the line
settled handy - made progress over 2f out - went to the front over 1f out - driven and drifting left before being overtaken on the line

awkward at the start and racing at the back - driven over 2f out - moved left and made progress but lacked experience and drifted left again over 1f out - up to third comfortably inside final furlong - unable to threaten the leading two
in front from the off - pushed along and caught over 2f out - overtaken over 1f out with nothing more to find inside final 110 yards
towards the centre of the field - encouraged over 2f out - stayed on inside final furlong without getting closer
prominent on the outer - driven and inexperienced over 2f out before dropping back over 1f out

up with the pace - on terms over 2f out before fading from over 1f out
spent the race at the back

settled towards the back - up to sixth and driven 2f out - unable to make ground 1f out but stayed on strongly inside the final 100 yards

in front early - driven over 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong and denied by the winner to drop to third near the line
settled handy towards the centre of the field - niggled along over 2f out - stayed on but unable to match the front-runners from over 1f out

spent the race at the back
slow to begin - spent the race behind
settled handy towards the centre of the field - driven and toiling on the outer over 2f out
towards the centre of the field on the outer - faded over 2f out

Held up in the pack - was niggled along over 2f out - made ground to close on the front-runner over 1f out - kept on bravely under strong pressure over the final 110 yards - went down by the narrowest of margins in a driving finish
Travelled in third - came under pressure over 2f out - hit the front for a stride inside the final furlong - overtaken again but stayed close up - kept on to the finish

Settled towards the back of the field and came under pressure over 3f out - dropped away and finished a long way behind
Took a strong hold and settled at the back for the whole race

went to the front early before sitting close up and back in front entering the straight - asked for effort 2f out - driven inside the final 150 yards but overtaken late on

settled towards the back - travelled easily - made ground on the outside into a fleeting second entering the straight - driven 2f out - soon driven without making further ground over 1f out and found nothing more

driven from the stalls - up with the pace and still in contention over 2f out - faded inside final furlong
raced in the pack early - improved position over 3f out - unable to challenge the front-runners final 2f
sluggish start - held towards the rear - kept on final 110 yards but remained detached
raced in the pack - made no further progress final 2f
sluggish start - spent the race towards the back of the field
raced in the pack - lost ground travelling wide over 2f out - soon faded
raced up with the pace early - drifted left and ran wide before dropping back rounding the bend over 5f out - faded over 2f out
dwelt at the start - held up towards the back for the remainder

settled towards the back - up to fifth and driven 2f out - unable to make ground 1f out - stayed on strongly inside the final 150 yards to finish best of all
went to the front - driven over 2f out and soon overtaken by a short margin early in the final furlong - unable to fight back and slipped to third near the line
hesitant at the start - soon settled close up and 4th halfway - asked for effort with 2f to run and driven to hold the same level inside the final 150 yards
up with the front runners and 3rd halfway - driven with 2f to run and found nothing more inside the final 150 yards

raced freely early - sat close up behind the pacesetter - shifted left 2f out then went ahead over 1f out - finished strongly inside final furlong

settled in third - driven and angled to challenge on the outside over 2f out - unable to threaten and faded inside final 110 yards

Showed inexperience racing in mid-division - niggled along before halfway - took no real part in the finish
Travelled in fourth - came under pressure over 2f out - was full of running to get on terms and score close home
Drifted right from the stalls - hit the front early - was niggled along over 1f out - opened up an advantage over the rest inside the final furlong - saw the margin cut and was caught close home

in the pack early - fell to the rear 4f out - soon struggling and never got competitive

Held up towards the back - made progress at the 13th and up to second after the 14th - blundered at the 17th - battled on but could not trouble the winner up the run-in

up in third early - in a fight for second 3f out - came under pressure and fell away over 1f out

settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - soon struggling
